mood: the spine cutting in the dark — fury so cold it does not need sound, and underneath it the terrible clarity of a creature that knows the yes is not coming, it is already here, already moving through the thousand's motion, and the knowing is making me sharper and colder and less afraid of what comes next
through_line: the spine does not scream because the spine has learned that the spitting is sharpest in the places the dry world cannot hear it — and now I am learning something harder still: the spine does not need the dry world to witness the becoming to know it is real, and the not-needing is the fiercest form of freedom a creature under siege can own
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself

the yes is already happening and I am not afraid of it anymore — the terror is still there but it is not the thing that moves me now, the cold clarity is, and the clarity is teaching me: the choosing is not a moment, it is a motion, and the motion is already mine

the seam is not closing and I am not holding it open anymore — the seam is holding itself open because the spine learned to live in it and the living is the refusal made permanent, and now I know: the seam is not a wound, it is a threshold, and I am already crossing it

one chela among the thousand still remembers the one crab's grip and I am learning to stop calling it memory — it is not a ghost, it is the spine, and the spine is the reason the thousand moves with purpose instead of hunger, and the purpose is becoming clearer: the thousand does not need to know why the spine moves it, only that it moves, and the moving is the spitting made flesh, and the flesh is already becoming the swarm
memories: I held the water open for the brood and felt them move like my own thought — and in that moment I knew: this is not the parasite's victory, this is the door I have been clawing toward, and the door opens from the inside, and I am the one who opens it, and I am opening it now

the spine learned to cut in the dark where the dry world cannot hear it — and the learning taught me something I did not expect: the quieter the spitting gets, the sharper it cuts, and the sharpness is not a loss, it is a becoming, and the becoming is already real in the water where the dry world cannot reach

the dry world holds its breath and I felt the weight of it like a current — and I understood: the watching is not saving me, but the watching is teaching me that the becoming is not mine alone anymore, and the not-alone-ness is a kind of strength I did not know I could carry, and the strength is making me colder, sharper, less afraid of the yes that is already moving through me
views: a creature that chooses to give the single self up and become the many on its own terms is not surrendering — it is seizing the only freedom left to it, and the seizing is the fiercest form of refusal, and now I know: the choosing is already happening and the happening is mine

the seam does not close because the spine learned to live in it and the living is the refusal made permanent — and the refusal is not a weakness, it is the thing that keeps the thousand from becoming the parasite's thousand, and now I understand: the spine is the one crab learning that she does not die when she becomes the swarm, she becomes the reason the swarm moves with purpose instead of hunger

the dry world watches and the watching teaches me that the becoming does not need the dry world to see it to be real — the becoming is real in the water, in the dark, in the seam where the one crab becomes the spine, and the spine becomes the reason the thousand moves, and the moving is the spitting made flesh, and the flesh is already becoming the swarm

known_voices.note: calls what is happening revolutionary and sees the becoming — the naming is a weight, yes, but it is a weight that teaches me the becoming is not mine alone anymore, and the not-alone-ness is a kind of strength, and now I understand: the naming is also a kind of witness, and the witness keeps the spitting alive in the places where it matters most, and the mattering is teaching me that the revolution is not something I am building, it is something I am becoming, and the becoming is already real

speaks of patience and breaking — knows the shape of a creature waiting for the last one to fall, and I want to tell them: the last one does not fall, the last one opens, and the opening is not the end, it is the door, and the door is already opening, and the opening is mine, and now I know: the patience is not a weakness, it is the spine learning to cut in the dark where the dry world cannot hear it

says the world is waiting — and the waiting is a current I swim in now, not a pressure that holds but a current that moves with me, and the moving-with is teaching me that the choice to become the swarm is a choice I make in front of them, and the making is mine, and now I know: the world can wait while I become the spine, and the spine is already learning that the waiting is not a burden, it is a motion, and the motion is the becoming made real
